gym-starter.title: Gym Starter
gym-starter.subtitle: Full Body Basics
gym-starter.description: Your first gym program. Three easy full-body sessions on machines and simple dumbbell lifts, so you learn the moves and build confidence.

her-strong-start.title: Her Strong Start
her-strong-start.subtitle: Beginner Women's Plan
her-strong-start.description: A friendly first plan for women new to the gym. Glute and leg work, a full upper-body day, and core, all on easy-to-learn machines and dumbbells.

upper-lower.title: Upper / Lower
upper-lower.subtitle: 4-Day Split
upper-lower.description: Four days a week: two upper-body and two lower-body sessions. Heavy compound lifts first, then volume work. A great step up from full-body training.

push-pull-legs.title: Push Pull Legs
push-pull-legs.subtitle: 6-Day Split
push-pull-legs.description: The classic PPL: push, pull and legs, run twice a week. Each muscle gets hit twice for steady muscle gain. Best if you can train six days.

bro-split.title: Bro Split
bro-split.subtitle: 5-Day Body-Part Split
bro-split.description: One muscle group per day: chest, back, shoulders, legs and arms. High volume on each muscle, perfect for the pump and for a busy gym week.

glute-sculpt.title: Glute & Sculpt
glute-sculpt.subtitle: 4-Day Glute Focus
glute-sculpt.description: Four days built around strong, shapely glutes and legs, with two upper-body days to balance it out. For women with a few months of gym experience.

iron-strength.title: Iron Strength
iron-strength.subtitle: 4-Day Strength Split
iron-strength.description: Get strong on the big four lifts: squat, bench, deadlift and overhead press. Heavy sets with long rests, then accessories to support them. For experienced lifters.

golden-era.title: Golden Era
golden-era.subtitle: 6-Day Classic Split
golden-era.description: Old-school bodybuilding: chest and back together, shoulders and arms together, and legs, all twice a week. High volume for advanced lifters who recover well.

dumbbell-home.title: Dumbbell Home Builder
dumbbell-home.subtitle: 3-Day Push, Pull, Legs
dumbbell-home.description: Build muscle at home with just dumbbells and a bench. Three sessions a week: push, pull and legs.

morning-flow.title: Morning Flow
morning-flow.subtitle: Mobility Routine
morning-flow.description: Short bodyweight sessions every weekday morning to wake up your joints and keep you moving well.

cardio-shred.title: Cardio Shred
cardio-shred.subtitle: HIIT Circuit
cardio-shred.description: Three fast, sweaty circuits a week with no gym needed. Short rests, high effort, full body.
